Title: Boulder City Council Study Session - July 27, 2023

Topic1.Title: Police Oversight Ordinance Revision Process Update
Topic1.Summary: Consultant Farah Muscadin presented preliminary observations, community feedback from a June 2023 forum, and progress of the Police Oversight Ordinance Work Group. Recommendations include making the independent monitor a liaison rather than a panel member, formalizing panel onboarding and training, and creating a standard operating procedure for case review and discipline. Council asked about ordinance versus implementation issues, the meaning of 'oversight,' monitor hiring, outside counsel, panel size, and grievance processes. The timeline calls for a draft, a late-summer community event, first reading in the fall, and a recommendations packet around October.

Topic2.Title: Use Table and Standards Update: Neighborhood Center Changes
Topic2.Summary: Senior Planner Lisa Hood presented the third module of the Use Table and Standards project, which focuses on neighborhood centers and walkable 15-minute neighborhoods. Proposed changes include streamlining restaurant approvals, allowing duplexes and townhomes on ground floors in BT and BR zones, prohibiting vehicle-related uses in downtown zones, and allowing uses such as post offices, small retail, and small music venues. Public input from a story map, questionnaire, and pop-up events showed strong support for restaurants and local businesses and concern about vehicle-oriented uses. Council generally supported streamlining restaurants and extending flexibility to the Hill, while raising concerns about ground-floor residential uses, vehicle-use prohibitions, hostels, and private club lodges. The questionnaire closes July 31, with planning board review in August and ordinance readings in October and November.
